theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl a₂⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha' hb' =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a' ⬝ b', .refl (a' ⬝ b'), .par ha' hb'⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      let ⟨a₃, ha⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha' ha''
      let ⟨b₃, hb⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb' hb''
      exact ⟨a₃ ⬝ b₃, .par ha.1 hb.1, .par ha.2 hb.2⟩
    case red_I a' =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha']
      exact ⟨b', .red_I b', .refl b'⟩
    case red_K a c =>
      let ⟨a₂', ha₂'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a ha
      rw [ha₂'.2]
      exact ⟨a₂', ha₂'.1, .red_K a₂' c⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      let ⟨a'', c', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c a' ha
      rw [h.2.2]
      use a'' ⬝ b' ⬝ (c' ⬝ b'), .red_S a'' c' b'
      constructor <;> simp_all
  case red_I a' =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a', .refl a', .red_I a'⟩
    case par c a₁' hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible c hc]
      exact ⟨a₁', ha, .red_I a₁'⟩
    case red_I a'' => exact ⟨a', .refl a', .refl a'⟩
  case red_K a c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a, .refl a, .red_K a c⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      let ⟨a₁', h'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a a' ha
      rw [h'.2]
      exact ⟨a₁', h'.1, .red_K a₁' c'⟩
    case red_K a' c' => exact ⟨a, .refl a, .refl a⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      use a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c)
      exact ⟨.refl _, .red_S a b c⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      let ⟨a', b', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      rw [h.2.2]
      use a' ⬝ c' ⬝ (b' ⬝ c')
      constructor
      · apply ParallelReduction.par
        · exact .par h.left hc
        · exact .par h.2.1 hc
      · exact .red_S a' b' c'
    case red_S a' b' c' => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .refl _⟩
